context.transcript:
Why did Ms. Kim oppose funding our new project?
A. Did you see the latest budget cuts?
B. I'm looking forward to the opening of the new cafe.
C. I will have it sent to her.
context.transcript_translation:
金女士反对资助我们的新项目的原因是什么？
A. 你看到最新的预算削减了吗？
B. 我期待着新的咖啡馆开业。
C. 我会把它发给她。

choices: Did you see the latest budget cuts?

items.question: Why did Ms. Kim oppose funding our new project?
